name: groff export (ms, PDF)
description: Exports an ordinary page, not a report: as groff ms source and, through groff (-T pdf), as a nicely typeset PDF: for notes, procedures and documents written in Markdown. It never handles patient data: reports (the reports namespace) and any page with a patient block are refused. The preamble (page setup, font family) and the font are set here. Needs the groff package (ms macros and gropdf) and a font with the language's glyphs.

groff.label: groff (full path)
groff.help: GNU groff with the ms macros and the PDF device (gropdf): the Debian/Ubuntu package `groff`, not `groff-base`

font.label: Font family
font.help: A groff font family (T = Times, H = Helvetica, BT = the family of a font you installed). It is the -f option and fills {font} in the preamble. It must have the glyphs of the report's language: ă â î ș ț

preamble.default:
.nr PO 2c
.nr LL 17c
.nr PS 11p
.nr VS 14p
.nr PD 4p
.ds FAM {font}
preamble.label: Preamble
preamble.help: The first lines of the .ms file: page setup and the font family ({font} is the setting above). Only comments (.\") and the requests nr ds as ll po ps vs pl hy nh ad na fam ft lt ls blm cflags hw are accepted: nothing that reads a file or runs a command.
